paragraphs.source_en: “If trade between our two sides is to continue smoothly, I believe one matter must be settled once and for all—and that will require a momentous decision.”

units.source_en: “If trade between our two sides is to continue smoothly, I believe one matter must be settled once and for all—and that will require a momentous decision.”

ja.t: せねばならず、そのためには

units.source_zh: “为了双方能继续顺利交易，我以为，必须彻底解决一事，要下大决心。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “为了双方能继续顺利交易，我以为，必须彻底解决一事，要下大决心。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. Namely, we must harden our hearts and drive Hideyori out of Osaka!”

units.source_en: Namely, we must harden our hearts and drive Hideyori out of Osaka!”
units.source_zh: 那就是：狠下心，把秀赖赶出大坂！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。那就是：狠下心，把秀赖赶出大坂！”

paragraphs.source_en: “What? You, who are so close to the Toyotomi clan, would say such a thing?”

units.source_en: You, who are so close to the Toyotomi clan, would say such a thing?”

ja.t: しいそなたが、そのようなことを

units.source_zh: 你与丰臣氏如此亲近，竟说出这等话来？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “什么？你与丰臣氏如此亲近，竟说出这等话来？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Sir, please hear me out first. Questions of faith cannot be resolved by words or by force of arms. If we try to suppress them by force, it will become impossible to live at peace with the lands overseas. Such, for what little it is worth, is my humble opinion.”

units.source_en: Questions of faith cannot be resolved by words or by force of arms.

ja.t: できるものではありません。

units.source_zh: 信奉问题不能用言语或刀兵解决。

units.source_en: If we try to suppress them by force, it will become impossible to live at peace with the lands overseas. Such, for what little it is worth, is my humble opinion.”

ja.t: しくなりましょう。これが

units.source_zh: 勉强弹压，便难再与海外和平相处，这是晚生的微末之见。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “先生，且先听晚生说。信奉问题不能用言语或刀兵解决。勉强弹压，便难再与海外和平相处，这是晚生的微末之见。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Therefore, if we wish to continue trading with the lands overseas, we must remove the hidden threat entirely.”

units.source_en: “Therefore, if we wish to continue trading with the lands overseas, we must remove the hidden threat entirely.”
units.source_zh: “故，若希望继续与海外做生意，就应彻底消除隐患。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “故，若希望继续与海外做生意，就应彻底消除隐患。”

paragraphs.source_en: Kōetsu stared intently at Yoichi. He had never imagined that such words would come from Suminokura Yoichi’s lips.

units.source_en: He had never imagined that such words would come from Suminokura Yoichi’s lips.
units.source_zh: 他未想到会从角仓与市口中说出这等话来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 光悦直直注视着与市。他未想到会从角仓与市口中说出这等话来。
